{{Quote|My family has held high positions in the Imperial military for generations. Both my father and mother were proud scions of the Tyrak lineage!|Moff Tyrak|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
The '''Tyrak lineage''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] with a history of service in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. However, the family interbred; the [[Tyrak's grandfather|grandfather]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] married [[Tyrak's aunt|his own niece]], and Tyrak's own [[Tyrak's mother|mother]] and [[Tyrak's father|father]] were first cousins either once or twice removed. As a result, Tyrak was "eccentric."
